verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform, so managed global AI inference is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no inference API or single-call model endpoint. Multi-region deployment ('run your application closer to where your users are') and CPU/RAM scaling are adjacent hosting features. 'Bring Your Own Models' only changes which model powers Railway's own dashboard agent, so it is not a user-facing inference service either.

support.subject: As an ai-native builder, I can run AI model inference globally with a single call without managing GPUs or capacity planning
